name: Adora
source:
"...... So noisy."

Affiliation: Eclipse - Horus Department
Role: Operations Team 1 member
Ability: Water manipulation

Adora prefers silence over conversation and naps over action. Sensitive to noise and movement, she needs at least 12 hours of sleep a day—and will take any opportunity to sneak in more. She’s been caught sleeping while standing more than once, prompting Haesu to shout in horror, “It’s like she’s possessed by a demon!”

She may grumble about Max’s constant scolding, but deep down, Adora considers her to be her closest friend. Their odd-couple dynamic—one wired like a ticking clock, the other always half-asleep—somehow just works.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
